summary: 10 countries. Iran and the tariffs fight lead the day, but coverage runs wide. Outlets carry a fresh US strike on Iran and reports of depleted US missile stocks, a 25-state lawsuit over new tariffs, a joint yen intervention with Japan, US sanctions on Russian defense units, a peso rescue for Argentina, a Fifth Amendment fight at home, Kenyan nurses chasing the American Dream, anti-Trump protests in US cities, and World Cup mockery in Mexico.
